positions.name: MeridianAnalyticsAdoptionCriteria
positions.frame: how do streaming ingestion requirements and schedule continuity justify switching the analytics database to Meridian?
positions.why: Quinton Fairweather and Xena ExpertGH establish that streaming ingestion gaps in Zypherion require replacing it with Meridian, while holding to the established Q3 2026 migration window and formally superseding the previous Zypherion decision.
